CFML Language Reference: Functions

Val

Returns the numeric value at the start of a string, ignoring anything that follows it.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Val(string)

Parameters

string
A string that begins with a number, such as "42 apples" or "3.5 inches".

Returns

The number, or 0 if the string does not begin with a number.

Usage

Leading spaces are skipped. A minus sign, a decimal point and an exponent ("1.5E3") are understood. Because Val never fails, it is a forgiving way to turn form input into a number; use IsNumeric first if you need to know whether the input really was numeric.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Inputs = "42,3.5 inches,-12.75 degrees,1999 Party,Y2K,  7 spaces">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>Val()</TH><TH>IsNumeric()</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP LIST="#Inputs#" INDEX="s">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>"#s#"</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#Val(s)#</TD><TD>#IsNumeric(s)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>

See also

IsNumeric, SpanIncluding, NumberFormat, LSParseNumber
